title: app-shell: the inbox tick re-fetches sys_notification_receipt?top=200 in full every 10 s — never incrementally
body:
Confirmed on the running showcase during the objectui#7249 re-measurement (2026-09-03): every inbox poll tick issues `GET /api/v1/data/sys_notification_receipt?top=200&filter=…channel=inbox` alongside the `sys_inbox_message?top=20` read, pulling the receipt set in full each time (10 s foreground, 60 s hidden). The cadence itself is correct (objectui#7249 closed as not-reproduced); this is the one factual sub-claim of that card that survives. A since-cursor or a receipts-for-the-listed-messages read would cut the steady-state payload to a few rows.

Filed as a `finding` for triage (small efficiency item, no user-visible harm measured).
